title: node_health_evaluate is O(nodes x packets): measure rescans the full packet array per slot
detail: Each per-tick evaluation calls measure per slot, each scanning every packet; cost multiplies with 5.1 growth and long runs (3200-tick test loops).
recommended_fix: Single pass over flow.packets accumulating per-node stuck units into a scratch array, then map slots to levels.
